page.overview:
Who is Carl?

Carl was a minor character appearing in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

Carl is shown to have a big hatred for dinosaurs, especially Bumpy. This can be seen when Carl says that he will be happy when Bumpy is dead.

Carl is first seen driving his truck when he tries to kill Bumpy by running her over. This causes Bumpy to fight back, before Sammy intervenes and protects Carl. Carl then goes on a dinosaur hating rant, before driving away. Later, an Atrociraptor pack came to hunt down the campers. The Atrociraptors kill Carl, before hunting down the others. Darius and Ben find Carl's corpse inside of his truck.
